definitions.explanation: A fence made of wooden boards or planks arranged vertically or horizontally. A traditional form of property enclosure, less ornamental than other Japanese fence types.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{板垣|いたがき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}んだ→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧。
examples.english: I enclosed the garden with a plank fence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{板垣|いたがき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: The old plank fence fell over in the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {隣家|りんか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{境|さかい}→境：02822_sakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{板垣|いたがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{立|た}て{直|なお}した→立て直す：03113_tatenaosu⟧。
examples.english: We rebuilt the plank fence on the boundary with the neighboring house.

notes:
⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧ (board, plank) + {垣|かき} (fence, hedge), with rendaku changing かき to ⟦がき→ガキ：09305_gaki⟧. One of several traditional fence types in Japanese architecture.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生|い}け{垣|がき}: living hedge made of plants — uses plants instead of wood
- ⟦{竹垣|たけがき}→竹垣：27396_takegaki⟧: bamboo fence — uses bamboo poles, more decorative
- ⟦{塀|へい}→塀：03613_hei⟧: wall, solid fence — sturdier, often masonry or thick wood
- ⟦{柵|さく}→柵：13103_saku⟧: fence, railing — usually open structure with bars or slats

NOTE: {板垣|いたがき} is also a common Japanese surname, most famously borne by {板垣|いたがき} {退助|たいすけ} (1837–1919), a prominent Meiji-era politician.
